name: documents
description: Real document production: PDF, DOCX, QR codes, source notebooks and report-grade briefs.

commands.name: pdf
commands.template: Create a real PDF about: {input}. Pass the title and the full body, with headings and a table where the facts are tabular. For a report with several sections, set document mode so the file has a cover and a table of contents. Then verify the file.

commands.name: docx
commands.template: Create a real DOCX about: {input}. Pass the title and the full body as headings, lists and tables. This call creates a new file. Then verify the file.

commands.name: report
commands.template: Create a sourced briefing on: {input}. Read every local source first. Deliver a PDF with sections, figures and a source line, then verify the file. A URL you have not read is a gap.

tools.name: create_pdf
tools.description: Creates a quality-checked PDF document from markdown-like text. The result names the finished file — never guess or invent a path, and never tell the user which folder it went to. Use this for Executive Summary documents, structured reports, source references, attachments and high-quality summaries.

content.description: Body content as markdown-like text (# headings, bullets, paragraphs). A whole line ![chart](/absolute/path.svg) embeds a local chart or diagram; create it with generate_chart or create_diagram using theme='light' so it matches the page.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

template.description: Layout preset: one of report, brief, analysis, checklist.

document.description: When true, the file opens with a cover and a table of contents, then the body. Use this for a report with several sections.

tools.name: create_docx
tools.description: Creates a real Word document (.docx) from a markdown subset: # headings, bullets, numbered lists, tables (| a | b |), paragraphs. Use this for letters, reports and documentation as an editable Word file.

title.description: Title shown as the heading (also the file-name base).

content.description: Body content as markdown-like text (# headings, bullets, paragraphs).

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

tools.name: create_qrcode
tools.description: Creates a real, scannable QR code as PNG. Use this for URLs, WiFi access data, contact data, texts.

data.description: Content of the QR code (URL, text, WiFi data)

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

fill_color.description: Mark colour. Default is the product green.

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Reads the full text out of a local PDF file. Returns the text page by page, page markers included. Use only when a PDF path exists.

path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the PDF file.

tools.name: build_document
tools.description: Document Factory: builds a report-grade briefing PDF from local source files and optional web research — executive summary, key findings, analysis, next steps and source notes — then verifies the PDF really has pages. Returns DOCUMENT_BUILT_VERIFIED with the file path only on success.

source_paths.description: Comma-separated absolute or ~-relative paths to local files (txt/md/py/html/pdf) used as evidence.

include_web_research.description: Add web research to the evidence base (default true)

filename.description: Optional output filename — the file is delivered as an artifact; the result line names it

tools.name: export_source_brief
tools.description: Exports a high-quality markdown briefing from a local source notebook: executive summary, evidence register and source manifest. Use this for reliable reports, study guides, project briefings and source documentation.

notebook_path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the SOURCE_NOTEBOOK_FILE JSON manifest.

question.description: Optional focus question the brief must answer.

filename.description: Optional output file name (a bare name, not a path); the result line names the finished file.

tools.name: create_source_notebook
tools.description: Creates a local source notebook from files or folders. Indexes text/PDF/code into citable evidence chunks and stores a local manifest. Use this when the user wants to work with documents, sources, knowledge, source grounding, study notes or citable quotes.

paths.description: One or more local files/folders — absolute or ~-relative, e.g. ['~/Documents/report.pdf', '~/Documents/project'].

notebook_id.description: Optional stable file name or slug.

tools.name: query_source_notebook
tools.description: Queries a local source notebook and returns a conservative, source-grounded answer with evidence chunks in the format [S001-C001]. Use this after create_source_notebook or when an existing notebook manifest is given.

notebook_path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the SOURCE_NOTEBOOK_FILE JSON manifest returned by create_source_notebook.

question.description: Question that must only be answered from the indexed sources.

tools.name: verify_artifact
tools.description: Evidence gate for generated deliverables. Verifies that a file or project directory really exists and is complete (PDF page count, deck slide count, DOCX/XLSX content, project required files). Returns ARTIFACT_VERIFIED or ARTIFACT_FAILED with metrics. Always call this before announcing an artifact as finished.

path.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to the file or project directory to verify.

checks.description: JSON object with optional keys: kind (auto|pdf|pptx|docx|xlsx|project|file|image), min_pages, min_slides, min_words, min_sheets, min_rows, min_files, min_bytes, required_files (array of relative paths)

changelog: 1.2.0 - the document tools ask the host. The body, the path and the source text stay out of the bridge row. 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
